title: 第一百五十九章能人周一星第一百五十八章李家开辟新世界
slug: 多子多福照顾女帝一天修为涨一万
lines: “好强，究竟是何等大人物降临到此方天地，难道是大乘期的老怪？”
谢天龙感觉浑身刺痛，低下头不敢再看虚空那道鬼影了。
“陛下，此人不是我能够推算的。”
“我年轻时曾经遇到过万魂老祖血洗城池，咱们今天所遇到的力量比万魂老祖还要强，至少也是大乘期巅峰的老怪物。”
赤红的鲜血顺着眼角留下来，周一星闭着双目缓缓走来。
显然，他也想窥探一丝衣角，奈何自己的天机之力不到家。
刚刚推算，那张鬼影就算定了他。
好在强行中断了天机之力，不然自己已然是一个死人了。
“唉，这样破碎的虚空，要是没有大能干预，只怕千年时光都无法恢复了。”
谢天龙叹息一声，眸子中又是绝望又是担忧的。
这些年真是怪事频发，先是遇到了李长寿那位前辈，随后炼虚秘境，各种圣地级势力降临，又有这档子事。
这皇帝之位真是累啊！
“咯咯咯，你就是这个国家的皇帝吧！”
一道诡异充满魔性的声音回荡天地，影魅在黑色漩涡中从天而降，站在空间乱流中。
那恐怖的气息足以撼天动地，压得谢天龙周一星等人直接跪了下去，没有丝毫反抗的念头。
“前...辈，我...是梁国皇帝谢天龙。”
谢天龙在威压之下断断续续地说道，整个人满头大汗。
他是皇帝不假，但也要懂得审时度势。
在大乘期老怪面前，举手投足间，便可毁灭一国。
影魅也不废话，凝聚出李长寿、叶凝霜、梦可儿三人的画像，冷声道：“这三个人你可认识？”
谢天龙微微一愣，看向三人每一个认识的。
这也怪画像中是年轻版李长寿，之前和他见面的就是马甲丧彪版、老年版，根本就没见过。
还有这两女，生得如此绝艳。
“回前辈的话，三人没有见过。”
谢天龙回过神，恭敬开口。
这可惹恼了影魅：“没有见过，那你们就去死吧！”
刚想发怒，旁边的周一星恭敬开口：“前辈且慢，里面有一人我见过。”
听到这话，影魅收了神通，看向地上那道血淋淋的身影：“我想起来了，就是你想要窥探本天魔。”
“不过也无妨，只要你能够说出一人的消息来，你们都可活。”
谢天龙投去一个希望的目光：不愧是咱们梁国的宰相，咱们梁国的顶级天机师，等到这次危机度过，必定让你和朕一样，一人之下万人之上。
“那个男人和那个风韵女子我不认识，但那个长相清纯的女娃子，若我所料不错她是血杀殿的千金，也就是那位殿主的女儿。”
“前辈只需要前往血杀殿，便可顺藤摸瓜找到您想要找到的人。”
“血杀殿。”影魅简单思索了一下问道：“方位在何处？”
周一星满头大汗：“城东八百里有一处血杀殿分殿，我想那里会有前辈想要的答案。”
“好，本天魔暂且信你，若是有假，我会将你们的国度灭国！”
两枚种子落下，直入二人体内。
黑影消失，谢天龙噗的一声瘫倒在地，完全没了皇帝的姿态。
取而代之的则是对生命的珍惜。
“周宰相...周爱卿，你所说的消息保真吗？”
谢天龙担忧地问道。
如果只是缓兵之计，他便会立刻带着皇子爱妃头也不回地逃离此方天地，不再回归。

"So strong, what kind of big man came to this world? Is he an old monster from the Mahayana period?"
Xie Tianlong felt tingling all over his body and lowered his head, not daring to look at the ghost in the void anymore.
"Your Majesty, this person is not someone I can predict."
"When I was young, I once encountered the Ancestor of Ten Thousand Souls who bloodbathed the city. The power we encountered today was even stronger than the Ancestor of Ten Thousand Souls. It was at least an old monster at the peak of the Mahayana period."
Red blood stayed along the corners of his eyes, and Zhou Xing walked slowly with his eyes closed.
Obviously, he also wanted to take a peek at the corner of his clothes, but his divine power was not enough.
I just calculated that the ghostly image has determined him.
Fortunately, he forcibly interrupted the power of Tianji, otherwise he would have been a dead man.
"Alas, such a broken void, if there is no powerful intervention, I am afraid that it will not be able to recover in a thousand years."
Xie Tianlong sighed, his eyes filled with despair and worry.
Strange things have happened frequently in recent years. First, I met the senior Li Changshou, and then various Holy Land-level forces came to the Secret Realm of Refining the Void, and this happened again.
The position of emperor is really tiring!
"Keke, you must be the emperor of this country!"
A strange and demonic voice echoed around the world, and the shadow fell from the sky in a black vortex, standing in the turbulence of space.
The terrifying aura was enough to shake the heavens and the earth, causing Xie Tianlong and Zhou Xing to kneel down without any thought of resistance.
"Senior, I am Xie Tianlong, Emperor of the Liang Kingdom."
Xie Tianlong said intermittently under pressure, and his whole body was sweating profusely.
It is true that he is the emperor, but he must also know how to assess the situation.
In front of the old monsters in the Mahayana stage, a country can be destroyed with just a few gestures.
Yingmei didn't talk nonsense, condensed the portraits of Li Changshou, Ye Ningshuang, and Meng Ke'er, and said coldly: "Do you know these three people?"
Xie Tianlong was slightly startled and looked at everyone he knew among the three of them.
This is no wonder that the portrait shows a young version of Li Changshou. The people I met before were the Sangbiao version and the elderly version, but I have never seen him before.
And these two girls are so stunningly beautiful.
"Replying to senior, the three of them have never met."
Xie Tianlong came back to his senses and spoke respectfully.
This irritated Ying Mei: "I haven't seen it before, so just go to hell!"
Just when he was about to get angry, Zhou Xing next to him said respectfully: "Senior, wait a minute, there is someone inside that I have seen."
Hearing this, Yingmei withdrew her magical power and looked at the bloody figure on the ground: "I remembered, it was you who wanted to spy on this demon."
"But it doesn't matter. As long as you can tell the news about one person, you can all live."
Xie Tianlong cast a hopeful look: You are worthy of being the prime minister of our Liang Kingdom and the top secret master of our Liang Kingdom. When this crisis is over, you will be like me, one person is inferior to ten thousand people.
"I don't know that man or that charming woman, but that innocent-looking girl, if I expected it right, she is the daughter of the Blood Killing Palace, that is, the daughter of the palace master."
"Senior, you only need to go to the Blood Killing Hall and you can follow the clues to find the person you want to find."
"Blood Killing Hall." Yingmei thought briefly and asked, "Where is the location?"
Zhou Xing was sweating profusely: "There is a branch of the Bloody Murder Hall eight hundred miles east of the city. I think there will be the answers that seniors want there."
"Okay, I will believe you for the time being. If there is any lie, I will destroy your country!"
Two seeds fell and went straight into their bodies.
The black shadow disappeared, and Xie Tianlong collapsed to the ground with a pop, completely losing his emperor's posture.
Instead, there is a cherishment of life.
"Prime Minister Zhou...Zhou Aiqing, is the information you said true?"
Xie Tianlong asked worriedly.
If it was just a delaying tactic, he would immediately take the prince and his beloved concubine and flee from this world without looking back, never to return.
